name: waypoint
description: Plan pane: the steps the session is working through, and the PRs/MRs that need attention.

openOnStart.title: Open pane on start
openOnStart.description: Open the plan pane when a plan is found at session start (placed only in wide terminals; the band shows otherwise).

band.title: Band above prompt
band.description: Draw a one-line plan summary above the prompt while the pane is not placed.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Pin the current step under the prompt.

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: auto picks compact inline and wide when docked.

planDir.title: Plan directory
planDir.description: Where /waypoint use <slug> looks for plan files.

planPollSeconds.title: Plan poll (seconds)
planPollSeconds.description: How often the plan file is stat-ed for outside edits; 0 disables.

resumeDays.title: Resume window (days)
resumeDays.description: A plan last touched within this many days comes back in a new session in the same directory.

pollSeconds.title: PR poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often tracked PRs/MRs are polled with gh/glab; minimum 30.

notify.title: Native notifications
notify.description: Also raise a system notification when a PR/MR starts needing attention (toasts always show).
